scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. Can an expert who once worked on a port project sit on the committee that checks whether that port caused coastal erosion?
On thirtieth October, twenty twenty six, a single bench of Honourable Justice Harisankar V Menon of the Kerala High Court ruled.
scenes.shown: On 30 October 2026, a single bench of Honourable Justice Harisankar V. Menon of the Kerala High Court ruled.

scenes.dialogue: Residents of fishing villages north of the Vizhinjam seaport say its construction eroded their coast. In twenty twenty two, the State formed an expert committee.
scenes.shown: Residents of fishing villages north of the Vizhinjam seaport say its construction eroded their coast. In 2022, the State formed an expert committee.

scenes.dialogue: It was to check whether the port work caused erosion, and suggest remedies. It inspected the site just once. Its report, the State says, blamed high waves and cyclones.
The petitioners alleged a conflict of interest. The chairman, they said, had served on a technical sub committee for this very seaport since twenty twelve.
scenes.shown: The petitioners alleged a conflict of interest. The chairman, they said, had served on a technical sub-committee for this very seaport since 2012.

scenes.dialogue: Another member, they said, held a senior post in a company linked to the port's concessionaire. And the report, they argued, contradicted the chairman's own paper.
The Court rejected the delay plea; the petition concerns the twenty twenty two committee. On bias, mere suspicion won't do; a reasonable likelihood will.
scenes.shown: The Court rejected the delay plea; the petition concerns the 2022 committee. On bias, mere suspicion won't do; a reasonable likelihood will.

scenes.dialogue: No respondent disputed the chairman's earlier role, so his inclusion ought to have been avoided. The other member's link was not denied by the port respondents.
The committee's constitution was declared flawed; its report is not to be acted upon. The Government must form an independent committee, free of conflict.
